# Correlation matrix (`correlation-matrix` v1)

Pairwise correlations used by basket, quanto and spread products.

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `CORR` · **Identifiers:** `CORR-…` in `matrixId`

Open one with `CORR <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: correlation-matrix
version: 1
description: "Pairwise correlations used by basket, quanto and spread products."
match: { kind: correlation-matrix, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Correlation matrix, id: $.matrixId }
strip:
  - { label: Name, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Size, bind: size($.factors) }
  - { label: Average, bind: $.average, fmt: price2, emphasis: true }
panels:
  - id: pairs
    kind: table
    title: Pairs
    key: F2
    rows: $.pairs
    columns:
      - { label: Factor 1, bind: "@.a" }
      - { label: Factor 2, bind: "@.b" }
      - { label: "ρ", bind: "@.rho", fmt: price2, tone: sign }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F8: impact, F9: raw }
```

| Name | `$.name` | text |
| Size | `size($.factors)` | text |
| Average | `$.average` | `price2` |
